I can’t directly use your device’s microphone or speakers in this chat, so we can’t have a real-time voice conversation here.

But you still have a few options:
- **Type-to-chat here** (what we’re doing now).
- **Use your phone/OS dictation** to speak and have it turn your speech into text, then paste/send it here (and you can use text-to-speech on your side to hear my replies).
- If you’re building an app: you *can* make a voice experience by connecting **speech-to-text (STT)** + **text-to-speech (TTS)** to the API and streaming audio.

If you tell me what platform you’re on (iPhone/Android/Windows/Mac/web) or whether you’re trying to build an app, I can give you the best setup.
